definitions.applicable_events: Public records whose applicability rule names this source (the source is a row of their source matrix).
definitions.data_returned_events: Public records whose current query outcome for this source is DATA_RETURNED.
definitions.declared: The source contract is in this release's versioned source universe.
definitions.events_with_executed_receipts: Public records with at least one executed receipt for this source.
definitions.events_with_retained_records: Public records that keep rights-cleared rows (aliases, measurements, notices, reports or products) from this source.
definitions.executed_query_receipts: Persisted query receipts for this source with an executed terminal outcome, summed over records.
definitions.outcome_counts: Current query outcome per record for this source (one outcome per applicable record).
